summary: This Form 6-K reports the resignation of independent director Jean Christophe Baron Von Pfetten, effective June 30, 2026, with no disagreement, and the appointment of Bo Lyu as independent director and audit/compensation/nominating committee member, effective July 1, 2026. The company entered into indemnification and independent director agreements with Mr. Lyu. The changes are routine board succession, not a forced departure. Because this is a non-US filer, the Form 6-K maps to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02. No deal terms exist; the filing is purely administrative.
